# Mail.ru
> Russian internet portal offering email, cloud storage, news, media, games, and account services.

Mail.ru is a major consumer web platform operated within VK, centered on Mail.ru Mail and related online services. Its public web presence spans email access, cloud storage, media products, account management, help materials, and legal information.

## Core Services
- [Mail](https://mail.ru/): Main webmail entry point for Mail.ru email accounts.
- [Cloud](https://cloud.mail.ru/): Cloud storage service for file backup, sharing, and synchronization.
- [Calendar](https://calendar.mail.ru/): Web calendar service integrated with Mail.ru accounts.
- [Notes](https://notes.mail.ru/): Note-taking service tied to the Mail.ru ecosystem.
- [My](https://my.mail.ru/): Social and personal profile service within the Mail.ru network.
- [Answers](https://otvet.mail.ru/): Community question-and-answer platform for user-generated knowledge.
- [Games](https://games.mail.ru/): Portal for browser, client, and online games.

## Account and Access
- [Account Login](https://account.mail.ru/login): Central sign-in page for Mail.ru account access.
- [Account Signup](https://account.mail.ru/signup): Registration page for creating a new Mail.ru account.
- [Password Recovery](https://account.mail.ru/recovery): Account recovery flow for restoring access credentials.
- [Account Settings](https://account.mail.ru/user): User account management and profile settings area.
- [Security](https://account.mail.ru/user/2-step-auth): Two-factor authentication and account protection settings.
- [Help with Login](https://help.mail.ru/mail/account/login): Help articles for sign-in and access problems.

## Mail Help
- [Mail Help Home](https://help.mail.ru/mail): Main help center for Mail.ru Mail features and troubleshooting.
- [Registration](https://help.mail.ru/mail/account/signup): Guidance for creating a new mailbox.
- [Login Problems](https://help.mail.ru/mail/account/login): Instructions for resolving sign-in issues.
- [Password Recovery](https://help.mail.ru/mail/account/restore): Steps for restoring mailbox access.
- [Mail Settings](https://help.mail.ru/mail/settings): Documentation for mailbox configuration options.
- [Folders and Filters](https://help.mail.ru/mail/letters): Help for organizing messages, folders, and rules.
- [Spam and Security](https://help.mail.ru/mail/security): Recommendations for spam handling and mailbox protection.

## Cloud Help
- [Cloud Help Home](https://help.mail.ru/cloud_web): Main support documentation for Cloud Mail.ru.
- [Getting Started](https://help.mail.ru/cloud_web/about): Overview of Cloud Mail.ru capabilities and basics.
- [Upload and Download](https://help.mail.ru/cloud_web/upload): Instructions for transferring files to and from cloud storage.
- [Sharing Files](https://help.mail.ru/cloud_web/share): Guidance for creating shared links and access options.
- [Sync and Apps](https://help.mail.ru/cloud_web/app): Information about desktop and mobile cloud applications.
- [Storage Management](https://help.mail.ru/cloud_web/size): Details on quotas and storage usage.
- [Security](https://help.mail.ru/cloud_web/security): Security-related help for cloud accounts and files.

## Mobile and Apps
- [Mail for Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ru.mail.mailapp): Android application for Mail.ru email access.
- [Mail for iPhone and iPad](https://apps.apple.com/ru/app/%D0%BF%D0%BE%D1%87%D1%82%D0%B0-mail-ru/id511310430): iOS app for Mail.ru Mail.
- [Cloud for Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ru.mail.cloud): Android application for Cloud Mail.ru storage.
- [Cloud for iPhone and iPad](https://apps.apple.com/ru/app/%D0%BE%D0%B1%D0%BB%D0%B0%D0%BA%D0%BE-mail-ru/id912125010): iOS app for Cloud Mail.ru.
- [Mail Mobile Help](https://help.mail.ru/mail/mobile): Help resources for using Mail.ru Mail on mobile devices.
- [Cloud App Help](https://help.mail.ru/cloud_web/app): Support information for cloud applications and synchronization.

## Media and Content
- [News](https://news.mail.ru/): News portal covering current events and topical reporting.
- [Auto](https://auto.mail.ru/): Automotive media with reviews, news, and vehicle information.
- [Health](https://health.mail.ru/): Health-focused editorial content and reference materials.
- [Lady](https://lady.mail.ru/): Lifestyle and magazine-style content portal.
- [Children](https://deti.mail.ru/): Parenting and family-oriented editorial content.
- [Pets](https://pets.mail.ru/): Articles and information about pets and animal care.
- [Hi-Tech](https://hi-tech.mail.ru/): Technology news, reviews, and product coverage.

## Community and Entertainment
- [Answers](https://otvet.mail.ru/): User Q&A community for practical and general-interest questions.
- [My World](https://my.mail.ru/): Social networking and profile platform for Mail.ru users.
- [Horoscopes](https://horo.mail.ru/): Horoscope and astrology content service.
- [Cinema](https://kino.mail.ru/): Movie and entertainment portal with listings and editorial content.
- [TV](https://tv.mail.ru/): Television schedules and related media information.
- [Games](https://games.mail.ru/): Gaming hub with titles, news, and player resources.

## For Senders and Administrators
- [Postmaster Home](https://postmaster.mail.ru/): Mail.ru sender resources for email delivery and reputation.
- [Authentication](https://postmaster.mail.ru/authentication): Guidance on sender authentication requirements and setup.
- [Bulk Sending Rules](https://postmaster.mail.ru/rules): Requirements and recommendations for mass email senders.
- [Reputation](https://postmaster.mail.ru/reputation): Information about sender reputation and delivery quality.
- [Feedback Loop](https://postmaster.mail.ru/fbl): Complaint feedback loop details for senders.
- [Postmaster FAQ](https://postmaster.mail.ru/faq): Frequently asked questions for mail administrators and senders.
